# Generated by ppc worldbuilder: vanilla file patched so fleets sent over the open sea never target a river channel; do not edit by hand.
#Age of Renaissance
sponsor_a_cathedral_decision = {
	decision_category = government_decisions

	potential = {
		current_age = age_2_renaissance
		religion.group = religion_group:christian
	}

	allow = {
		current_age = age_2_renaissance
		has_ruler = yes
		has_advance = cathedral_advance
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = sponsor_a_cathedral_cooldown_tt
			NOT = {
				ruler = { has_variable = sponsor_a_cathedral_cooldown }
			}
		}
		any_owned_location = {
			NOT = {
				has_building = building_type:cathedral
			}
			OR = {
				location_rank = location_rank:city
				location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -10

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.gold >= {
						value = root.monthly_income_trade_and_tax
						multiply = 6
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
	}

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = interior
		10 = happy
	}

	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:clergy_estate }
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_building = building_type:cathedral
				}
				OR = {
					location_rank = location_rank:city
					location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
				}
			}
			weight = {
				base = 1
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = population
						multiply = 100
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = target_location
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = sponsor_a_cathedral_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			add_political_influence = political_influence_mild_penalty
			add_religious_influence = religious_influence_severe_penalty
			scope:target_location = {
				construct_building = {
					building_type = building_type:cathedral
					cost_multiplier = 0.90
					cost_multiplier_reason = "royal_sponsorship"
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				ruler = {
					set_variable = sponsor_a_cathedral_cooldown
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

construct_a_grand_palace_decision = {
	decision_category = government_decisions

	potential = {
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
		exists = capital
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		capital = {
			has_great_or_unique_palace = no
		}
		total_building_levels_including_construction:grand_palace < 1
	}

	allow = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		country_rank_level >= 2
		has_ruler = yes
		capital.market = {
			is_traded_in_market = goods:ivory
			is_traded_in_market = goods:goods_gold
			is_traded_in_market = goods:marble
		}
		political_influence >= 20
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -10

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.gold >= {
						value = root.monthly_income_trade_and_tax
						multiply = 6
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
	}

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = interior
		10 = happy
	}

	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:nobles_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }
		create_character = {
			artist = architect
			estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
			min_age = 25
			max_age = 50
			artist_skill = { 0.4 0.9 }
			create_in_limbo = yes
			save_scope_as = target_artist
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = construct_a_grand_palace_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			add_political_influence = political_influence_severe_penalty
			capital = {
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:grand_palace }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = construct_a_grand_palace_decision.a_tt
				scope:target_artist = {
					move_country = root
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

#Age of Discovery
strive_towards_thalassocracy_decision = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country

	potential = {
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
	}

	allow = {
		num_of_ports > 10
		OR = {
			capital = { pp_is_sea_coast = yes }
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = strive_thalassocracy_coastal_markets_tt
				any_port_in_country = {
					is_market_center = yes
					count >= 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -40

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.num_of_ports > 20
				}
				add = 35
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.monthly_sailors > 2
				}
				add = 35
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.navy_size_percentage >= 0.75
				}
				add = 60
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.monthly_balance < 5
				}
				add = -50
			}
		}
	}

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = exterior
		10 = happy
	}

	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate }
	}

	option = {
		name = strive_towards_thalassocracy_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = thalassocracy_striving_modifier
				years = 20
				mode = replace
			}
			custom_tooltip = strive_towards_thalassocracy_decision.a.tt
			hidden_effect = {
				trigger_event_silently = {
					id = thalassocracy_events.1
					years = 20
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

abandon_thalassocracy_decision = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country

	potential = {
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		has_variable = thalassocracy_achieved
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			num_of_ports < 10
			NOT = { capital = { pp_is_sea_coast = yes } }
			NOT = {
				any_port_in_country = {
					is_market_center = yes
					count >= 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -40

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.num_of_ports < 5
					NOT = { root.capital = { pp_is_sea_coast = yes } }
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
	}

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = interior
		10 = regular
	}

	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate }
	}

	option = {
		name = abandon_thalassocracy_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			set_societal_value = { type = land_vs_naval value = -25 }
			remove_country_modifier = thalassocracy_achieved_modifier
			remove_variable = thalassocracy_achieved
			if = {
				limit = { has_reform = government_reform:thalassocracy_reform }
				remove_reform = government_reform:thalassocracy_reform
			}
		}
	}
}

#Age of Reformation
found_trade_company_india_decision = {
	decision_category = economy_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country

	potential = {
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
		NOT = { c:POR ?= root }
	}

	allow = {
		capital = {
			NOT = { continent = continent:asia }
			NOT = { continent = continent:oceania }
		}
		has_advance = trade_companies_advance
		has_embraced_institution = institution:global_trade
		OR = {
			any_market_with_merchants = {
				location.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
			}
			any_market_with_merchants = {
				location.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { value = 100 }

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = regular
		10 = exterior
	}

	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate }
	}

	option = {
		name = found_trade_company_india_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			change_societal_value = { type = capital_economy_vs_traditional_economy value = societal_value_large_move_to_left }
			change_societal_value = { type = mercantilism_vs_free_trade value = societal_value_large_move_to_right }
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = asian_trade_boom_modifier
				years = 50
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
}

#Age of Absolutism
invite_foreign_advisor_decision = {
	decision_category = government_decisions

	potential = {
		current_age = age_5_absolutism
	}

	allow = {
		current_age = age_5_absolutism
		has_ruler = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = invite_foreign_advisor_cooldown_tt
			NOT = {
				ruler = { has_variable = invite_foreign_advisor_cooldown }
			}
		}
		societal_value:traditionalist_vs_innovative < 25
		any_known_country = {
			great_power_ranking > 20
			NOT = { this = root }
			societal_value:traditionalist_vs_innovative > root.societal_value:traditionalist_vs_innovative
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -10

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					root.gold >= {
						value = root.monthly_income_trade_and_tax
						multiply = 8
					}
				}
				add = 50
			}
		}
	}

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = interior
		10 = happy
	}

	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				great_power_ranking > 20
				NOT = { this = root }
				societal_value:traditionalist_vs_innovative > root.societal_value:traditionalist_vs_innovative
			}
			save_scope_as = target_country
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			ruler = {
				set_variable = invite_foreign_advisor_cooldown
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = invite_foreign_advisor_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			add_political_influence = political_influence_mild_penalty
			change_gold_effect = { scale = -4 }
			change_societal_value = { type = traditionalist_vs_innovative value = societal_value_large_move_to_right }
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = invite_foreign_advisor_decision.a.tt
				create_character = {
					min_age = 25
					max_age = 50
					estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
					religion = scope:target_country.religion
					culture = scope:target_country.culture
					adm = { 40 100 }
					dip = { 40 100 }
					mil = { 40 100 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = invite_foreign_advisor_decision.b

		ai_chance = { value = 0 }
		effect = {
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus }
		}
	}
}

disempower_the_parliament_decision = {
	decision_category = government_decisions

	potential = {
		current_age = age_5_absolutism
	}

	allow = {
		current_age = age_5_absolutism
		has_ruler = yes
		any_owned_location = {
			has_building = building_type:urban_parliament_seat
		}
		societal_value:absolutism_vs_liberalism < 10
		political_influence >= 30
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = disempower_the_parliament_decision_cooldown_tt
			NOT = {
				ruler = { has_variable = disempower_the_parliament_decision_cooldown }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = -10
	}

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = interior
		10 = angry
	}

	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:nobles_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				has_building = building_type:urban_parliament_seat
			}
			weight = {
				base = 1
				modifier = {
					add = {
						value = population
						multiply = 100
					}
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = target_location
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			ruler = {
				set_variable = disempower_the_parliament_decision_cooldown
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = disempower_the_parliament_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			add_political_influence = political_influence_extreme_penalty
			add_government_power = government_power_severe_penalty
			scope:target_location = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = disempower_the_parliament_decision.a_building_tt
					destroy_building = "building(building_type:urban_parliament_seat|owner)"
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = disempower_the_parliament_decision.a_tt
					every_pop = { 
						limit = { owner ?= root }
						add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_severe_penalty
					}
				}
			}
			change_societal_value = { type = absolutism_vs_liberalism value = societal_value_move_to_left }
			
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = disempower_the_parliament_decision.b

		ai_chance = { value = 0 }
		effect = {
			add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
			add_political_influence = political_influence_mild_penalty
		}
	}
}

abolish_serfdom_decision = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country

	potential = {
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
	}

	allow = {
		societal_value:serfdom_vs_free_subjects < -50
		stability > 0
	}

	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = angry
		10 = exterior
	}

	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:peasants_estate background = estate_type:peasants_estate }
	}

	option = {
		name = abolish_serfdom_decision.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			set_societal_value = { type = serfdom_vs_free_subjects value = 20 }
			add_stability = stability_radical_penalty
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_severe_penalty }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = abolish_serfdom_decision.b
		ai_chance = { value = 0 }
		effect = {
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
			add_government_power = government_power_extreme_bonus
		}
	}
}

jewish_expulsion_threat = {
	decision_category = religious_decisions

	potential = {
		religion ?= {
			OR = {
				group ?= religion_group:christian
				group ?= religion_group:muslim
			}
		}
		religion_percentage_in_country = {
			religion = religion:judaism
			value > 0.01
		}
	}

	allow = {
		at_war = no
		has_ruler = yes
		political_influence >= 10
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = jewish_expulsion_threat_cooldown_tt
			NOT = {
				ruler = { has_variable = jewish_expulsion_threat_cooldown }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = -150
			desc = "BASE_VALUE"
		}

		add = {
			desc = "$spiritualist_vs_humanist$"
			value = root.societal_value:spiritualist_vs_humanist
			multiply = -1
		}

		add = {
			desc = "$MODIFIER_TYPE_NAME_tolerance_heathen$"
			value = root.modifier:tolerance_heathen
			multiply = -50
		}

		add = {
			desc = "$MODIFIER_TYPE_NAME_global_pop_conversion_speed_modifier$"
			value = root.modifier:global_pop_conversion_speed_modifier
			multiply = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = jewish_expulsion_threat.a
		effect = {
			add_political_influence = political_influence_mild_penalty
			add_gold = {
				value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax
				multiply = {
					value = 100
					multiply = "religion_percentage_in_country(religion:judaism)"
				}
			}
			change_societal_value = {
				type = spiritualist_vs_humanist
				value = societal_value_huge_move_to_left
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = jews_may_choose_to_leave_tt
				every_owned_location = {
					limit = { "religion_percentage(religion:judaism)" > 0 }
					save_temporary_scope_as = jewish_expulsion_origin_location
					province_definition = { save_scope_as = jewish_expulsion_origin_province_definition }
					ROOT = {
						random_neighbor_country = {
							random_province = {
								limit = {
									NOT = { province_definition = scope:jewish_expulsion_origin_province_definition }
									province_capital = { NOT = { owner = ROOT } }
								}
								add_migration = {
									owner = ROOT
									religion = religion:judaism
									from_location = scope:jewish_expulsion_origin_location
									to_location = this.province_capital
									amount = {
										value = "scope:jewish_expulsion_origin_location.religion_population(religion:judaism)"
										multiply = { 0.25 0.5 }
										divide = 2
									}
									months = 2
								}
							}
						}
					}
					add_location_modifier = {
						modifier = jewish_expulsion_threat
						mode = replace
						years = modifier_duration_years_normal
						size = "religion_percentage(religion:judaism)"
					}
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				ruler = {
					set_variable = jewish_expulsion_threat_cooldown
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
